source_text: Surge et veni, proxima mea, speciosa mea, columba mea; in velamento petrae iuxta promurale ostende mihi faciem tuam, et auditam mihi fac vocem tuam, quoniam vox tua suavis et facies tua speciosa. Sponsus locum secretiorum ostendit: promurale murus ante murum; ibi velamine remoto facies et vox.
pass_a_gloss: Rise and come, near-one my, fair my, dove my; in covering of-rock beside outer-wall show to-me face your, and heard to-me make voice your, because voice your sweet and face your fair. Bridegroom place of-more-secret-things shows: outer-wall wall before wall; there with-veil removed face and voice.
pass_b_english: [[Arise and come, my near one, my fair one, my dove; in the covert of the rock beside the outer wall show me your face, and make your voice heard by me, for your voice is sweet and your face is fair >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:14]]. The Bridegroom shows a more secret place: the outer wall is a wall before the wall; there, the veil removed, are face and voice.
